question: List exclusively virtual schools (Virtual = 'F') where the percentage of students eligible for free meals (K–12) exceeds 8%, and that either opened after 1990 or have no closure date (i.e., still active). For these schools, return their name, city, county, total K–12 enrollment, and their rank in average reading score within their county—only include schools ranked in the top 15 per county.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s."XCL_041" AS cds,
         s."XCL_047" AS name,
         s."XCL_050" AS city,
         s."XCL_045" AS county,
         f."XCL_019" AS total_k12_enrollment,
         t."XCL_038" AS avg_reading
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_076" = 'F'
    AND f."XCL_020" * 100.0 / f."XCL_019" > 8
    AND (s."XCL_061" > '1990-12-31' OR s."XCL_062" IS NULL)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.county ORDER BY b.avg_reading DESC) AS rk
  FROM base AS b
)
SELECT name, city, county, total_k12_enrollment, rk
FROM ranked
WHERE rk <= 15
ORDER BY county, rk

WITH base AS (
  SELECT s."XCL_041" AS cds,
         s."XCL_047" AS name,
         s."XCL_050" AS city,
         s."XCL_045" AS county,
         f."XCL_019" AS total_k12_enrollment,
         t."XCL_038" AS avg_reading
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_076" = 'F'
    AND f."XCL_020" * 100.0 / f."XCL_019" > 8
    AND (s."XCL_061" > '1990-12-31' OR s."XCL_062" IS NULL)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.county ORDER BY b.avg_reading DESC) AS rk
  FROM base AS b
)
SELECT name, city, county, total_k12_enrollment, rk
FROM ranked
WHERE rk <= 15
ORDER BY county, rk

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT s."XCL_041" AS cds,
         s."XCL_043" AS name,
         s."XCL_050" AS city,
         s."XCL_045" AS county,
         f."XCL_005" AS enrollment,
         AVG(t."XCL_038") AS avg_reading
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f."XCL_001" = s."XCL_041"
  JOIN satscores AS t ON t."XCL_030" = s."XCL_041"
  WHERE s."XCL_044" = 'F'
    AND f."XCL_019" > 8
    AND (s."XCL_061" > '1990-12-31' OR s."XCL_062" IS NULL)
  GROUP BY s."XCL_041", s."XCL_043", s."XCL_050", s."XCL_045", f."XCL_005"
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT b.*,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.county ORDER BY b.avg_reading DESC) AS rk
  FROM base AS b
)
SELECT name, city, county, enrollment, rk
FROM ranked
WHERE rk <= 15
ORDER BY county, rk
